per_key.analysis: Accurate calm reachability status, consistent with shipped « injoignable ». Subject is the remote computer, not phone connectivity. Exact {device} is preserved once; no article/gender rewriting or name translation. Arbitrary-name substitution checks are string checks only.

Natural infinitive heading preserving both déplacer and copier, matching row_long_press_hint. « vers » introduces destinations rather than claiming work has begun. No final punctuation. Width risk F1 only.

per_key.english: This app can offer the devices your sessions show. A device with no visible session cannot be picked yet — open Local Operator on the other computer and pull the list to refresh.

per_key.analysis: Accurately restricts offered destinations to visible sessions, rather than claiming network-wide discovery. « pas encore » preserves yet; both ordered steps remain: open Local Operator on the other computer, then pull the session list downward to refresh. Professional vous imperatives Ouvrez/tirez; appareil/session/actualiser match the existing catalogue. Product name byte-exact. Width risk F2 only.

per_key.english: It did not answer when this computer asked.
per_key.current_text: Il n’a pas répondu à la demande de cet ordinateur.
per_key.analysis: « Il » refers to the previously displayed remote ordinateur; « cet ordinateur » remains the connected relay computer, not téléphone. « à la demande » naturally renders the request/answer relationship. Source usage confirms trimmed server reason wins and this is only the fallback; no server text translated.
Preserves other and visible; does not infer offline status or absence from the network. Singular agreement after Aucun is grammatical, not a missing ICU plural. appareil matches glossary.
Natural compact location fragment using ordinateur, parallel to shipped sidebar « Sur {device} ». Does not replace relay computer with phone; no punctuation drift.
« Actuellement » naturally labels current location, avoiding the urgency of « Tout de suite ». Sentence case and no punctuation match neighboring headings.
